race.description: Footts Swan Hill Demolition Group Mdn Plate
race.comment: SHE'S LOADED (8) is a seven-start maiden who finished fourth, beaten 5 lengths, when resuming from a spell last start over 1000m at Bendigo. Improvement to come and this is her chance to break through. SILENT GRIT (11) resumes after 6.5 months off but has been gelded since the last run and looks ready following a couple of trial wins. OTTALAUS (3) turned in a nice effort last time out at the second run of the campaign and finished just 0.8 lengths from the winner in second over 1000m at Ballarat Synthetic after being in contention on the corner. Tackling a more suitable race so he is a major player. PHENOMENORM (4) hadn't done much until the first-up third placing but that was a career-best effort and he can only be better for it. AGORAPHOBIC (12) was unplaced two runs back then again missed the frame last start over 1000m at Ballarat Synthetic, beaten 2 lengths into sixth. Best efforts measure up so worth another chance.
